title: 1808 Prairie gets its columned entrance loggia and side stair
items: The Keith house at 1808 Prairie now enters through an open stone loggia at its north end, as its 1888 photograph shows: paired columns on corner pedestals, a parapet across the front, and a balcony over it under the second-storey window.
A low arch opens under the loggia at basement level.
The front stair now rises beside the loggia on its south side instead of running straight out from the door, and the gate and front walk line up with it.
